classification: Read-only installed-source audit for connected tariff publication/quote/order qualification

targets.identity: public.execute_customer_delivery_rates_v1(p_action text, p_timestamp bigint, p_nonce uuid, p_idempotency_key uuid, p_payload_text text, p_signature text)
public.quote_customer_delivery_v1(p_timestamp bigint, p_nonce uuid, p_payload_text text, p_ip_hash text, p_signature text)
public.submit_guest_order_v1(p_timestamp bigint, p_nonce uuid, p_payload_text text, p_ip_hash text, p_signature text, p_guest_grant_hash text)
targets.result: TABLE(ok boolean, error_code text, retry_after_seconds integer, public_reference text, status text, subtotal numeric, discount_amount numeric, total_amount numeric, shipping_quote_status text, delivery_status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, guest_grant_token text)

triggers.name: order_delivery_history_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER order_delivery_history_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON k2_private.order_delivery_snapshots FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION k2_private.guard_order_delivery_history_v1()

triggers.name: order_delivery_history_truncate
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER order_delivery_history_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON k2_private.order_delivery_snapshots FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION k2_private.guard_order_delivery_history_v1()

orderGuards.name: order_delivery_charge_guard
orderGuards.definition: CREATE TRIGGER order_delivery_charge_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.order_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION k2_private.guard_order_delivery_charge_v1()

orderGuards.name: order_delivery_snapshot_required
orderGuards.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER order_delivery_snapshot_required AFTER INSERT ON public.order_requests DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION k2_private.guard_order_delivery_charge_v1()

findings.fact: Standard quotes resolve the active tariff head and calculate a fee from the corresponding immutable version. They return both inputFingerprint and rateVersion.
findings.implication: The connected fixture must witness the exact version and fee on both sides of publication; a quote response alone is not an accepted order.

findings.fact: Signed order verification and existing rate limits run before saved-order lookup; exact idempotent receipt/conflict handling precedes fresh quote/configuration/stock/identity/order construction.
findings.implication: A fresh-signature retry can retain an old saved charge after publication while legitimately adding signature/rate-limit state. Compare business snapshots separately; do not assert all private rows unchanged.

findings.fact: For a new order, resolved current quote must match the submitted input fingerprint and rate version. A mismatch raises22023/K2_DELIVERY_QUOTE_CHANGED before identity/order creation; routed handler maps it to409.
findings.implication: An unsubmitted old quote is reviewed again after a rate change; no silent replacement charge or automatic old-preview acceptance is implied. Exact runtime refusal and absence of newly accepted order still need evidence.

findings.fact: Accepted order stores resolved shipping amount, total, acceptance time and immutable private delivery snapshot. Guard compares standard shipping amount and total to retained snapshot; history guard refuses non-INSERT operations.
findings.implication: Acceptance before an edit should retain its agreed charge; actual persisted rows/snapshot/retry must prove this rather than relying on the owner tolerance decision.

findings.fact: Fresh standard ordering also requires valid Website publication, canonical items/stock/lots, signed transaction-bound nonce context and configured category depth.
findings.implication: Use an eligible synthetic listing and stock/lot fixture plus valid captured PSGC path, existing deadlines and genuine routed signed BFF calls. A direct resolver call or stubbed RPC does not qualify the connected flow.

runtimeQualificationRequirements: Get standard quote at retained versionA and accept orderA through production routed signed guest boundary; witness persisted charge, snapshot and reservation.
Publish versionB through production routed signed Admin boundary; prove orderA business rows/snapshot/charge stay unchanged.
Replay exact orderA with fresh signature after publication; same saved receipt and unchanged order/snapshot/reservation/message business state, separate legitimate nonce/rate state.
Submit a fresh key using old versionA acceptance after versionB publication; exact409 DELIVERY_QUOTE_CHANGED and no newly accepted order or unintended business rows.
Get new versionB quote and accept a new order with that acceptance; witness versionB fee and snapshot, keeping earlier orderA charge.
Exercise retained-charge/history guards in the owned fixture, explicitly distinguish SQL guard evidence from routed HTTP evidence.
Recover disposable synthetic effects and reconstruct exact original captured archive/catalog with scoped/full relation evidence; this is not production data-retaining recovery.
ownerBoundary: No rate-edit pause or editing-drain feature; shopping remains available, accepted orders keep agreed charges. Owner accepts a small loss on an order accepted before publication. Authority-through-commit understanding remains separate and unanswered.

independentReview.scope: Actual installed source/metadata, production router/handlers, snapshot triggers and exact semantic ordering reviewed; no runtime execution or synthetic RPC acceptance claim

limits: Source/captured installed catalog only; no new SQL/runtime/HTTP/provider/browser proof, no concurrent version boundary acceptance and no new recovery design. Current quote-change refusal is identified, not changed. Existing local publication and recovery receipts remain separate scopes.
recovery: Revert only this audit/documentation slice; preserve all prior runtime/provider state and receipts. MAP-018 owns connected local qualification and remaining real-host/provider gates.
